pro_course_detail.title: Individual English lessons (*All levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for all students who want to learn/improve their English faster than ever and speak fluent English confidently without being so shy and reserved.
I prepared for you the course with 5 main criteria:

1.Phrases - not individual words (collocations/connected speech)

2. No❌ grammar books and boring/long grammar explanations.  

3. Listen first! 

4. Listen - Answer - Repeat!

5. "Mirror effect" (it will enable you to teach yourself the language) 

+ a lot of useful material to get your English to the next level.

The lessons will be structured and personalised according to your specific needs:
1st - We will set a (realistic) goal.
2nd - Work out a step-by-step plan.
3rd - Focus on your strong areas (trust me you've got at least one :)) to gather courage and make them stronger, which would emphatically ensure your progress in the language learning journey!
4th - Figure out your weak areas right from day 1 and start working on them in a relaxed and pleasant way by *speaking through them.
* Yes, exactly speaking! otherwise English will be detached and you'll feel a disjunction between the language and you! As you cannot study a musical instrument without ever playing it!
In this course English will be taught by speaking 80% of the time!*
So bring your good mood and enthusiasm and let's get our first lesson started!;)

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice - BOOST YOUR CONFIDENCE
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel like you are scared of saying something or making a mistake? If so, these lessons are designed for you.

During our lesson we will have a relaxed conversation about topics important to you. You can feel free  pick up a topic you`d like to discuss, I`m always open for students suggestions. Conversational lessons focus on pronunciation, fluency, learning to speak with confidence, being able to articulate what you want to say. 

The goal of these lessons is to remain relaxed and feel free to express your thoughts. 
These lessons do not have homework.

Typically I do not make many corrections during the lesson in order to not break the conversational fluency practice. (I will make corrections during the lesson upon request of the student, and also if there is a repeating error which is hindering our time).

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
If you feel like you understand what people say but  there are so many grammar rules and exceptions so that you can`t understand where they should be used, these lessons are for you. 

Typically, the lessons` topics are based on students` needs. Before the lesson I contact a student to find out what kind of grammar he/she is willing to work on. If there is no specific tense or grammar part, I will recommend what we can work on based on mistakes made during the conversation. 

These lessons include homework in order to practice and repeat the material. 

During the lesson I will use PDF materials, presentations and specific grammar books.

I have a strong desire to see you succeed in your language learning goals. I want to see you become confident in your speaking ability and have fun while learning. As your teacher, I will help you to find the best inside of you. I will encourage you to be confident in your English or Russian. We will set goals and achieve them together. One of my favorite English sayings is, “don’t worry about failures, worry about the chances you miss when you don’t try”. I hope to see you soon! Меня зовут Анна. I'll teach you all about the Russian and English languages, and we'll practice conversation and grammar together. I love both my native language as well as the English language. • PDF downloads

pro_course_detail.description:
In these sessions, you’ll start learning English naturally — just like a child learns their first language. We’ll use the famous book English by the Nature Method by Arthur M. Jensen, which guides you through English step by step with stories, repetition, and real context.

What is the Natural Approach to Language Learning?

It’s a method that focuses on understanding and communication first — not memorizing rules or grammar drills. Just like you learned your native language, you’ll build vocabulary and confidence through immersion and exposure, not pressure.
